subject: VerdantAI discovery recap & next steps / follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@verdantai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@verdantai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: VerdantAI discovery recap & next steps

Hi Sam — great to meet you and Priya earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned:

Summary (what we heard)
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + Q&A over customer support tickets and call transcripts.
- Target latency: 150ms p95 for single-session chat flows (low-latency responses for agents).
- Data posture: sensitive PII in transcripts, prefer VPC/private deployment or strict KMS controls.
- Expected volume: ~200k API tokens/day initially, ramp to ~1.2M over 6-9 months.

Proposed next steps
1) Tech deep-dive with Rishi (redwood infra lead) — 60 minutes to review network/KMS options and model sizing (I’ve CC’d him).
2) Estimated pricing & configs — I attached a preliminary quote and integration checklist for your infra team to review (see attachments).
3) Pilot timeline — suggested pilot: 8 weeks (pilot config + 2-week validation window).

Can you confirm:
- Who on your side will own the technical integration (email + phone)?
- Any hard constraints on deployment dates or procurement cadence?

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote.pdf, redwood-integration-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up to schedule the tech deep-dive once I have your point of contact.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. Priya will own the integration on our side; I’m looping her in. A few quick notes:

- Piloting the summarization feature is our top priority for Q1.
- We have an existing KMS (AWS KMS) and will need Redwood to support customer-managed keys.
- Can you share ballpark pricing for the pilot + expected committed capacity if we go to Dedicated later?

If you can send pricing and a proposed time for the tech deep-dive next week, we’ll book it.

— Sam
